blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
A key factor in deciding whether to trust an automatic prediction is its confidence score , which should be calibrated to match the actual probability of the prediction being correct.
Most confidence calibration metrics target binary or multi - class tasks, while multi - label calibration remains largely underexplored.
Multi-label classification tasks, such as assigning medical codes to clinical notes or determining news topics, are usually dominated by a large number of negatives , i.e., labels that do not apply.
We show that existing binning schemes to compute label-wise expected calibration error either underestimate the error, simply reflect label frequency, or suffer from many bins with very few instances .
To achieve trustworthy label-wise calibration errors,
we propose
a new binning scheme that gives equal weight to positive and negative label assignments.
Our empirical study demonstrates that in contrast to existing binning schemes, our new scheme results in meaningful estimates of calibration error in hierarchical and in extreme multi-label classification.
We also show that calibrating confidence scores of large language models for multi-label predictions is an open challenge.
Our detailed analysis lays the foundation for further research by providing a solid evaluation metric for measuring calibration in multi-label classification.

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Many text classification tasks, such as medical coding, involve assigning multiple labels to each instance.
To enable humans to decide when (not) to trust machine predictions, prediction probabilities must be calibrated so that confidence scores reflect the empirical probability of the respective prediction being correct. 0 0 footnotetext: † Work done while at Bosch Center for Artificial Intelligence, Renningen, Germany.

blocks.en:
Existing calibration metrics largely address binary and multi-class classification ( Filho et al., 2023 ) and typically rely on binning predictions by their confidence. Prior work on calibration in multi-label classification ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng and Vasconcelos, 2024 ; Ullah et al., 2024 ) computes calibration errors on the union of all binary per-label
predictions
using standard calibration metrics for binary classification.
Importantly, this requires that binning is performed only once for the joint set of all label confidences.
However, this joint binning can conceal miscalibration of individual labels (see Sec. 4 ).
This poses problems if a user trusts the confidence estimate of a specific label, e.g., a medical code, because the classifier seems well-calibrated across labels, but is actually poorly calibrated on that specific label. We therefore propose to separately bin each label in multi-label classification problems.

Average confidence is the mean predicted probability for the label within a bin, and empirical probability is the fraction of instances in that bin that actually have the label. 2 2 2 Calibration error is often visualized with reliability diagrams ( Filho et al., 2023 , e.g.,) , showing the average prediction confidence on the linearly scaled x-axis and the empirical probability (fraction of positives) on the y-axis.
A linearly scaled x-axis makes sense with fixed-width binning schemes.

blocks.en:
A standard binning scheme for estimating calibration errors is fixed-width binning, which splits the probability interval [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] into n n evenly spaced intervals (see grey boxes in Fig. 1(a) ).
However, for individual labels in multi-label classification, the number of negative instances , i.e., where the label does not apply, typically exceeds that of positive instances by far, and thus models usually predict that a label does not apply ( negative prediction ) much more often than they predict that a label does apply ( positive prediction ).
Hence, fixed-width binning suffers from a large number of bins with very few instances (see “Support” in Fig. 1(a) and Sec. 6 ), making the resulting calibration error estimate unreliable.
Adaptive binning ( Nixon et al., 2019 ) constructs bins of approximately the same number of instances (see Fig. 1(b) ).
With many more negative than positive predictions, adaptive binning puts all positive predictions into a single bin (see Fig. 1(b) , where most bins have an average confidence close to 0, and the last bin covers a very wide prediction interval).
Thus, the resulting calibration error (the average of the differences between the average confidence and empirical probability, i.e., the fraction of positive instances in each bin) only marginally considers positive predictions.

然而,对于多标签分类中的单个标签,负实例的数量,即标签不适用的,通常远超过正实例的数量,因此模型通常预测一个标签不适用(负预测)的次数远多于它们预测一个标签确实适用(正预测)的次数.
因此,固定宽度的宾装有大量的垃圾箱,极少出现这种情况(见图1(a)和图6中的“支持”),因此所产生的校准误差估计不可靠。

与正数预测相比,许多负数比正数预测要多,适应性的binning将所有正数预测放入一个单一的bin(参见图1(b)),其中大多数bin的平均置信度接近0,最后一个bin覆盖了非常宽的预测间隔.
因此,由此产生的校准误差(平均置信度与经验概率之间的平均差数,即每桶中正例的分数)只略微考虑正数预测.

blocks.en:
We hence propose a new binning scheme for multi-label (ML) classification (adaptive ML ) .
Our core insight is that a reliable and practically relevant binning scheme for multi-label prediction must put equal weight on positive and negative predictions.
We hence apply adaptive binning separately to positive and negative predictions,
creating only as many bins as the smaller subset (usually positive predictions) can support while ensuring a minimum bin size (see Fig. 1(c) , where the first five bins contain only negative predictions and the last five bins contain only positive ones). Based on adaptive ML , we propose the multi-label expected calibration error ( ECE ML \text{ECE}_{\text{ML}} ), an unweighted average of the calibration errors of the individual bins (Sec. 4 ).
Empirically, adaptive ML binning scheme yields well-populated bins (Sec. 6 ) and thus a meaningful calibration metric for the multi-label case.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们提议一个新的多标签(ML)分类(适应性ML)的宾宁方案。
我们的核心洞察力是,一个可靠和实际上相关的多标签预测的二进制方案必须同样重视正负预测。
因此,我们对正负预测分别采用适应性宾加法则,
创建的宾箱数量只有较小的子集(通常是正数预测)所能支持,同时保证最小的宾箱大小(见图1(c),其中前五个宾箱只包含负数预测,后五个宾箱只包含正数预测). 基于适应性的ML,我们提出多标签预期校准错误(ECE ML\text{ECE\Text{ML}),这是单个垃圾箱校准错误的未加权平均值(第4节).
从经验上讲,适应性的ML binning 方案能产生人口密集的bin(第6节),从而为多标签案例提供有意义的校准指标。

blocks.en: We validate our binning scheme and ECE ML \text{ECE}_{\text{ML}} in an empirical study on two heavily imbalanced large-scale multi-label text classification benchmarks: RCV1-v2 ( Lewis et al., 2004 ) , which provides a hierarchical label set, and MIMIC-III-v1.4 ( Johnson et al., 2016 ) , which has a very large label set. We evaluate BERT-style models ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) and specialized models for the two datasets ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2022 ) in conjunction with methods to tackle class imbalance, as well as LLM-based classifiers in zero-shot and retrieval-augmented generation settings ( Milios et al., 2023 , RAG, similar to) , which may be a viable alternative to fine-tuned models if large-scale training data is not available.

blocks.en: In sum, our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: (1) We perform an in-depth analysis of pitfalls in directly applying single-label calibration metrics to the multi-label setting. (2) As a remedy, we propose adaptive ML , a robust new binning scheme for assessing per-label classification in multi-label classification. (3) Our empirical study on two large benchmarks shows that fine-tuned discriminative classifiers with focal loss achieve the best performance and calibration. (4) We find that fine-tuned classifiers outperform zero-shot LLM-based predictors. Although RAG considerably improves both performance and calibration of LLMs, they still fall short of fine-tuned classifiers and have a considerably higher inference time.

blocks.en: 2.2 Calibration and Class Imbalance in NLP
blocks.zh: 2.2 NLP的校准和类偏差

blocks.en:
Calibration in NLP. Most prior work on classifier calibration in NLP focuses on single-label tasks.
Here, BERT-style models have been shown to be poorly calibrated, often suffering from overconfidence ( Desai and Durrett, 2020 ; Kong et al., 2020 ; Guo et al., 2021 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) . Sachdeva et al. (2024) improve calibration of such models on extractive question-answering by counterfactually augmenting their training data. Calibration of generative LLMs is an open research topic ( Geng et al., 2024 ; Zhang and Wang, 2026 , see, e.g.,) .
Similar to discriminative models, confidence estimates can be derived from logits, but generative models can also be prompted to verbalize their confidence.
More advanced calibration techniques rely on the grouping of similar prompts and completions ( Detommaso et al., 2024 , e.g.,) .
blocks.zh:
在NLP校准. NLP中大多数先前的分类器校准工作都侧重于单标签任务.
在这里,BERT风格的模型被证明校准不高,常患有过度自信(Desai and Durrett,2020年;Kong等人,2020年;Guo等人,2021年;Kim等人,2023年). Sachdeva等人(2024年)在采掘问题回答方面改进了这种模型的校准,反之增加了培训数据。 基因LLMs的校准是一个开放的研究课题(Geng等人,2024年;张和王,2026年,参见,例如).
与歧视性模型类似,信心估计可以从logits中推导出来,但基因模型也可以被诱导来表达其信心.
更高级的校准技术依赖于类似 prompt和完成的分组(Detommaso等人,2024年,例如).

blocks.en:
Classifier Calibration on Imbalanced Data. Kranzlein et al. (2021) investigate single-label calibration with rare classes, proposing to evaluate calibration separately for classes with similar frequency and to also perform post-hoc recalibration based on these groups.
Focal loss has been successfully applied to a variety of imbalanced tasks in both computer vision and NLP ( Mukhoti et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Ghosh et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Yilmaz et al., 2023 , e.g.,) . Henning et al. (2023) give an overview on class imbalance methods in NLP.

blocks.en: We take inspiration from this literature to combine several promising sampling methods and loss functions when fine-tuning encoder models for multi-label classification.

blocks.en: 3 Issues when Computing Calibration for Multi-Label Classification
blocks.zh: 3 多标签分类计算校准时的问题

blocks.en:
In multi-label classification, Y Y is a random variable in { 0 , 1 } C \left\{0,1\right\}^{C} , with Y c = 1 Y_{c}=1 indicating that class c c applies (we call this assignment of 0 or 1 to a dimension in the label vector a label assignment ).
One may model the problem at the level of (i) individual labels, yielding a series of C C binary classification problems, or (ii) the full label vector, yielding a prediction problem over subsets of labels.
blocks.zh:
在多标签分类中,Y Y是{0, 1} C\left\0, 1\right\C}中的随机变量,其中Y c = 1 Y_{c}=1 表示 c 类适用(我们把这个 0. 或 1 的指派到标签矢量中的某个维度称为标签指派 ).
一种可能是在(一)单个标签一级建模问题,产生一系列C C二进制分类问题,或者(二)完整的标签矢量,产生相对于标签子集的预测问题.

blocks.en:
Historically, classical machine learning methods using features derived from word counts ( Kowsari et al., 2019 , see, e.g.,) were applied for multi-label text classification.
Computationally cheap methods like decision trees enable building higher-order classifiers (considering relations between labels) ( Zhang et al., 2022 , see, e.g.,) .
Neural classifiers based on Transformer encoders like BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) outperform count-based approaches ( Galke et al., 2022 ) , typically using a single sigmoid head for each label instead of higher-order classifiers due to their computational expense.
With the rise of powerful models to generate text, multi-label classification can also be approached using generative models (see Sec. 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
历史上,使用从单词计数衍生出来的特征(Kowsari等人,2019年,参见,例如)的古典机器学习方法被用于多标签文本分类.
诸如决策树等计算成本低廉的方法可以建立更高排序的分类器(考虑标签之间的关系)(Zhang等人,2022年,见,例如).
基于BERT(Devlin等人,2019年)等变形器编码器的神经分类器超越了基于计数的方法(Galke等人,2022年),由于计算成本,通常每个标签使用单一的sigmoid头,而不是更高排序的分类器.
随着产生文本的强大模型的兴起,多标签分类也可以使用基因模型(见Sec 5.2 .

blocks.en:
The different modeling choices (i) and (ii) naturally lead to different notions of calibration.
Under (ii), a predicted set is correct if and only if it exactly matches the ground truth set of applying labels ( Li et al., 2019 ) , without distinguishing near-correct from highly deviant predictions.
For models that output per-label probabilities, a standard way to compute prediction set probability is to compute it as the product of the per-label prediction probabilities for inclusion or exclusion ( Li, 2019 , e.g.,) .
In large label spaces, prediction set probabilities computed this way become infinitesimally small, making calibration evaluation very hard (see App. A.1 ).
blocks.zh:
不同的建模选择(一)和(二)自然导致不同的校准概念.
在(二)下,一个预测的集如果并且只有在它与应用标签的地面真理集完全吻合时才是正确的(Li等人,2019年),而没有区分近正确和高度偏离的预测.
对于每个标签概率输出的模型,一个计算预测设定概率的标准方法,是将其计算为每个标签的预测概率的产物,以供列入或排除(Li, 2019, 例如).
在大的标签空格中,以这种方式计算的预测设定概率会变得无限小,使校准评价非常难(见App.A.1 )。

blocks.en:
If a multi-label problem with C C labels is modeled at the level of individual labels (i), considering the calibration of the C C individual label assignments per instance is a natural choice. Put more formally, this requires multi-label classifiers to be calibrated on the level of per-label decisions: ∀ p ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] ∀ c ∈ [ 1 . . C ] : \displaystyle\forall p\in\left[0,1\right]\;\forall c\in\left[1..C\right]: P ⁡ ( Y c = 1 ∣ f ​ ( X ) c = p ) = p \displaystyle P\left(Y_{c}=1\mid f\left(X\right)_{c}=p\right)=p\ (6) Prior work on calibration in multi-label classification in computer vision ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Cheng and Vasconcelos, 2024 ) has approximated Equation 6 by computing calibration errors on the union of all binary per-label classifications.
This means that binning is performed only once for all n ⋅ C n\cdot C label assignments in a multi-label classification task with n n instances and C C labels.
While intuitive at first glance, we argue that this procedure often leads to undesired effects of miscalibrated labels concealing the miscalibration of each other, e.g., an overconfident label concealing the underconfidence of another one, since binning happens before computing the error (see Fig. 4 ) in App. A.1 ).
In practice, this means that a user might put unjustified trust in the prediction of a specific label as the classifier seems well-calibrated across labels, but is actually poorly calibrated on that specific label.

如果C标签的多标签问题在单个标签(i)的级别上被建模,考虑到每个实例的C单个标签分配的校准是自然的选择. 更正式地说,这需要多标签分类器按照每个标签决定的级别校准: ∀ p ∈ p [0, 1] ∀ c ∈ c ∈ [1] :\displaystyle\ for all p\in\ left [0, 1\ right]\;\ for all c\in\ left [1..C\right] : P ⁡ (Y c = 1 ∣ f (X) c = p)\displaytyle 左转( YQQCQ) 1\ mid f\ 左转( 右转) = p\ p\ (6)计算机视觉中多标签分类的校准工作之前(Chen等人,2024年;Cheng and Vasconcelos,2024年)通过计算所有二进制/标签分类的结合上的校准误差,对方程式6进行了近似.
这意味着在带有 n 例和 C 标签的多标签分类任务中,对于所有 n → C n\ cdot C 标签任务只执行一次 binning 。
虽然乍一看就直觉,但我们争辩说,这一程序往往导致错误的标签掩盖彼此的错判,例如,过度自信的标签掩盖另一个人的不信任,造成不可取的效果,因为在App.A.1中,在计算错误(见图4)之前就发生了宾倒法(见图4)。
在实践中,这意味着用户可能不合理地信任对特定标签的预测,因为分类器似乎在各种标签之间进行了很好的校准,但实际上该具体标签上的校准很差。

blocks.en:
Ullah et al. (2024) discuss computing per-label calibration errors, but observe that this may be distorted by the large amount of easily recognizable non-applying labels ( easy negatives ) and propose to instead evaluate the calibration of the k k most confident labels per instance. For computing an error on these labels, they perform adaptive binning only once, again potentially inducing undesired effects of one miscalibration concealing the other.
Moreover, it is unclear how to choose k k , as the standard deviation of the number of assigned labels per instance can be rather substantial (e.g., 8.14 on MIMIC-III-v1.4, see Table 3 in App. A.2 ).
With a too low k k , we ignore too many relevant labels, and with a high k k , this score converges towards binning all n ⋅ C n\cdot C label assignments at once.
blocks.zh:
Ullah等人(2024年)讨论了计算每个标签的校准错误,但观察到这可能会被大量易于识别的非应用标签(容易的底片)扭曲,建议相反地评价每个实例的k最自信标签的校准. 对于计算这些标签上的误差,它们只进行一次适应性的宾客化,再次可能诱发一种错误的校准掩盖另一种错误的不良效果。
此外,还不清楚如何选择kk,因为每个实例所分配的标签数目的标准差可能相当大(例如,MIMIC-III-v1.4上的8.14,见App.A.2中的表3)。
使用太低的 k k,我们忽略了太多的相关标签,而使用高高的 k ,这个分数会一时间将所有 n QC n\cdot C 标签任务合并到一起.

blocks.en: 4 ECE ML \text{ECE}_{\text{ML}} : A New Calibration Metric for Multi-label Classification
blocks.zh: 4 ECE ML\text{ECE\\text{ML}:多标签分类的新校准度量衡

blocks.en:
In this section, we derive our proposed method to evaluate the calibration of individual labels in multi-label calibration.
We opt for computing the calibration error of each individual binary classification separately for the reasons discussed in Sec. 3 , enabling displaying label predictions with their confidence score and per-label calibration error.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们得出了我们提议的在多标签校准中评估个别标签校准的方法。
我们选择基于 Sec. 3 中讨论的理由,分别计算每个单位二进制分类的校准错误,从而能够以它们的信心分数和每个标签校准错误来显示标签预测.

blocks.en:
We propose to address the issue of many easy negative labels on the level of the binning scheme. ECE as defined in Equation 3 relies on a fixed binning scheme, in which bins may contain strongly varying numbers of predictions (see, e.g., Fig. 1(a) ).
This can lead to biased estimators ( Roelofs et al., 2022 ) .
However, applying adaptive binning ( Nixon et al., 2019 ) , which ensures roughly equal bin sizes, to the binary subtasks of a multi-label classification problem,
leads to the problem that most of the bins will only contain predictions close to 0. The remaining bin(s) will be very wide, conflating predictions with high confidence and those with low confidences (see, e.g., Fig. 1(b) ).
Put differently, standard adaptive ECE implicitly allocates resolution according to prediction density, which becomes pathological in multi-label settings.
One way to tackle this issue is to ignore all predictions below some threshold ϵ \epsilon ( Nixon et al., 2019 ) , but there is no obvious way to choose ϵ \epsilon , whose choice will greatly influence the resulting score.
Moreover, the method does not detect miscalibration below the threshold, i.e., if a classifier assigns probabilities below ϵ \epsilon when the label actually applies.
blocks.zh:
我们建议解决在宾胜计划层面许多容易的负面标签的问题。 Equation 3中定义的欧洲经委会依靠固定的宾箱方案,其中宾箱可能包含非常不同的预测数(例如见图1(a))。
这可能导致偏颇的估测(Roelofs等人,2022年).
然而,将可适应的binning(Nixon et al., 2019),确保了大致相同的bin尺寸,应用到一个多标签分类问题的二元子任务中,
导致一个问题,大部分的垃圾箱只包含接近0的预测. 其余的bin(s)将非常宽广,以高度的置信度和低置信度(例如,见图1(b))来综合预测。
换句话说,标准的适应性欧洲经委会隐含地根据预测密度分配分辨率,这在多标签环境中成为病理学。
解决这个问题的方法之一是忽略所有低于某个阈值的预测QQ\\epsilon(Nixon et al., 2019),但是没有明显的选择QQ\epsilon的方法,后者的选择将极大地影响由此产生的得分.
此外,该方法不检测阈值以下的校准错误,即如果分类者在标签实际适用时指定概率低于QQ\epsilon.

blocks.en:
Adaptive ML Binning. Instead of thresholding, we propose to separately bin positive and negative predictions in an adaptive scheme, respectively.
We assume that each label receives a confidence score separately and that a prediction is positive if the corresponding score ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 .
If a model achieves higher overall accuracy by predicting a label at a threshold different from 0.5, its confidences are not well-calibrated, and they can be scaled to the 0.5 threshold before applying adaptive ML as we exemplify in Sec. 5.2 .
However, if a threshold different from 0.5 is chosen for other reasons (e.g., safety concerns), we advise to not re-scale the original confidences, as the thresholds were not optimized during training.
It then depends on the use case if separate binning should be performed at the 0.5 threshold (assessing general model calibration) or at the chosen threshold (answering how well the model is calibrated for positive and negative predictions, respectively).
Different models should always be compared at the same threshold.
blocks.zh:
适应性ML宾宁. 我们建议在适应性方案中分别纳入正负预测,而不是设定门槛。
我们假设每个标签分别获得一个信任分,如果对应的分数为 0.5\geq 0.5,则预测为正数。
如果一个模型通过预测一个与0.5不同的阈值的标签来达到更高的整体准确性,那么它的置信度没有很好地校准,在应用适应性ML之前,可以被缩放到0.5阈值,我们在Sec. 5.2 中对此进行举例说明.
然而,如果出于其他原因(如安全考虑)选择了一个不同于0.5的阈值,我们建议不要重新调整原有的置信度,因为阈值在训练期间没有优化.
然后取决于在0.5阈值(评估一般模型校准)或所选阈值(分别回答该模型对正值和负值预测的校准程度)进行单独拆分时的使用情况。
不同的模型应始终在同一阈值上进行比较。

blocks.en:
Binning positive and negative predictions separately enables the calibration error to cover all predictions while giving equal weight to the two scenarios that are of interest to the user when deciding whether to trust a classifier: The label-wise calibration error should reflect (a) how good confidence scores are for the label if the label is predicted, and (b) how good confidence scores are if the label is not predicted. If the overall number of bins is specified to be b b , we reserve b 2 \frac{b}{2} bins for the two intervals, respectively.
We additionally constrain our binning procedure with a minimum bin size b m ​ i ​ n b_{min} .
If there are not enough positive or negative predictions for b 2 \frac{b}{2} bins of at least b m ​ i ​ n b_{min} size, we scale down the number of bins to ensure that each bin contains at least b m ​ i ​ n b_{min} predictions.
In the special case of having fewer positive or negative predictions than 2 ∗ b m ​ i ​ n 2*b_{min} , we use a single bin for positive and negative predictions, respectively. 4 4 4 See App. A.1 for a discussion of this design choice. If a label is never predicted by the classifier, we bin the negative predictions adaptively into b b bins.
In our experiments, we use b m ​ i ​ n = 5 b_{min}=5 and b = 10 b=10 . 5 5 5 We perform a sensitivity analysis for these hyperparameters in Sec. 6 . We call the resulting scheme adaptive ML . Fig. 2 exemplifies the results of the different binning schemes on a single label.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We conduct an empirical study to validate our new metric on RCV1-v2 ( Lewis et al., 2004 , henceforth RCV1 ) and MIMIC-III-v1.4 ( Johnson et al., 2016 , henceforth MIMIC-III ) , two large complex multi-label text classification benchmarks, which we describe in further detail in this section.
We compute micro- and macro-averaged F 1 , with macro F 1 being our key metric due to the imbalanced nature of the two datasets. Similar to Liu et al. (2019) , we additionally compute performance and calibration metrics separately for highly frequent, medium-frequency, and rare labels (with n ≥ 1000 n\geq 1000 , 100 ≤ n < 1000 100\leq n<1000 , and n < 100 n<100 positive instances, respectively 6 6 6 Pecher et al. (2024) found Transformer encoder-based models to outperform generative models on binary classification tasks with 100-1000 training examples. ). For dataset statistics including subset statistics, see App. A.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们进行了一项经验性研究,以验证我们关于RCV1-v2(Lewis等人,2004年,以后称为RCV1)和MIMIMIC-III-v1.4(Johnson等人,2016年,以后称为MIMIC-III)的两个大型复杂的多标签文本分类基准,我们将在本节中进一步详细描述。
我们计算微观和宏观平均F 1, 宏观F 1 是我们的关键衡量标准, 因为两个数据集的不平衡性质。 与Liu等人(2019年)类似,我们还分别对高频,中频,稀有的标签分别计算性能和校准度量度量度量度值(N + 1000 n\geq 1000,100 → < 1000 100\leq n<1000,n < 100 n < 100),分别为6 6 Pecher等人. (2024年)发现变形器编码器基于模型在二进制分类任务上能超越基因模型,有100-1000训练实例. ). 关于数据集统计,包括子集统计,见App.A.2.

blocks.en:
RCV1. RCV1 is a hierarchical news topic classification dataset with 103 unique labels and roughly 800,000 instances.
We use the official RCV1 test set (ca. 780,000 instances) and randomly split the official training set into a train, tune, and a dev set ( van der Goot, 2021 ) .
For our exploratory experiment with generative classifiers, due to their much higher runtime, we create a subsampled version of the RCV1 test set containing 5,000 instances (for sampling details, see App. A.2 ).
We compute hierarchical F 1 scores ( Kiritchenko et al., 2005 ) .
blocks.zh:
RCV1. (英语). RCV1是一个分级的新闻主题分类数据集,有103个独特的标签,大约80万例.
我们使用官方的RCV1测试集(约78万例),并随机将官方培训集分为火车,谐调,以及Dev集(van der Goot,2021).
对于基因分类器的探索性实验,由于其运行时间高得多,我们创建了包含5000例的RCV1测试集的子样本版本(样本详情见App. A.2.
我们计算F1级分数(Kiritchenko等人,2005年)。

blocks.en:
MIMIC-III. MIMIC-III is a medical coding dataset, i.e., the task is to assign codes (labels) to free-text medical notes with 8,930 unique labels and roughly 53,000 instances.
Following Mullenbach et al. (2018) , we predict both diagnosis and procedure codes and use their data split into training, dev, and test set.
We further randomly split the training set into a train and tune set and use Kim et al. (2022) ’s code preprocessing, but no text preprocessing.
While the codes are hierarchical, the task of human medical coders is to always assign the most specific code. 7 7 7 See Section B of the ICD-9-CM official guidelines for coding and reporting . We thus use the standard F 1 score here.
We follow Edin et al. (2023) in computing macro-averaged scores only on labels that occur in the respective evaluation set, and report macro-averages on all labels in App. A.4.2 .
blocks.zh:
军情三处。 MIMIC-III是一个医学编码数据集,即任务是为有8,930个独特标签和大约53,000例的免费文本医疗说明指定代码(标签).
继Mullenbach等人(2018年)之后,我们预测诊断和程序代码,并使用他们的数据分为培训、dev和测试集。
我们进一步随机将训练套件分为列车和调制组,并使用Kim等人(2022年)的代码预处理,但没有文本预处理.
虽然代码是分级的,但人类医学代码员的任务是总是指定最具体的代码. 7 7 见ICD-9-CM正式编码和报告准则B节。 因此我们在这里使用标准的F1分数.
我们跟随Edin等人(2023年),只计算相应评价集中出现的标签的宏观平均分数,并在App.A.4.2中报告所有标签的宏观平均分数。

blocks.en: 5.2 Models
blocks.zh: 5.2 模式

blocks.en:
Using our newly proposed method for evaluating calibration in multi-label classification, we compare a wide range of neural text classification methods.
Here, we describe the various setups we use for our models, including loss- and sampling-based methods for mitigating class imbalance effects, and obtaining confidence scores from LLMs.
blocks.zh:
使用我们新提出的多标签分类的校准方法,比较了广泛的神经文字分类方法.
在这里,我们描述了我们用于模型的各种设置,包括以损失和抽样为基础的方法减轻阶级不平衡效应,并从LLMs获得信心分数.

blocks.en:
Classifiers. We use BERT-based classifiers ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) and two SOTA model architectures specifically designed for RCV1 and MIMIC-III, respectively.
For RCV1, in addition to BERT, we evaluate HiDEC ( Im et al., 2023 ) .
HiDEC uses an encoder-decoder setup to generate a sequence of labels representing a path through the label hierarchy.
As our baseline, we train HiDEC with the HBM loss ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , a hierarchy-aware loss function specifically designed for HiDEC-like models that also optimizes label-specific prediction thresholds.
To enable comparison with confidence values from other models, we piecewise linearly re-scale the label-specific prediction confidences ( HiDEC-s , see App. A.3.1 ).
blocks.zh:
类者. 我们使用基于BERT的分类器(Devlin等人,2019年)和两个SOTA模型架构分别专门为RCV1和MIMIC-III设计.
对RCV1, 除了BERT, 我们评价HiDEC(Im等人, 2023年).
HiDEC使用编码器-解码器设置,通过标签等级来生成代表路径的标签序列.
作为我们的基线,我们用HBM损失(Kim等人,2024年)来训练HiDEC,这是专门为HiDEC类似模型设计的一种分级意识损失功能,它也优化了特定标签的预测阈值.
为了能够与其他模型中的置信值进行比较,我们以片面方式线性地重新标定标签特定的预测置信度(HiDEC-s,见App. A.3.1.).

blocks.en:
On MIMIC-III, we first compare BERT, BiomedBERT ( Gu et al., 2022 ) , and ModernBERT ( Warner et al., 2024 ) .
For BERT and BiomedBERT, we need to truncate the long medical notes due to their limited context windows, whereas ModernBERT can fit 8,192 tokens.
Yet, the domain-specific BiomedBERT model is the best model on the dev set (see Table 9 ).
Hence, we use this model as our underlying model for PLM-ICD ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , a model based on chunking and label attention.
blocks.zh:
在MIMIC-III上,我们首先比较BERT,BiomedBERT(Gu等人,2022年)和ModernBERT(Warner等人,2024年).
对于BERT和BiomedBERT来说,由于上下文窗口有限,我们需要缩短长的医学笔记,而ModernBERT可以装配8,192个令牌.
然而,特定域的BiomedBERT模型是Dev集上最好的模型(见表9 ).
因此,我们使用这个模型作为PLM-ICD(黄等人,2022年)的基础模型,这个模型基于块化和标签关注.

blocks.en:
Addressing Class Imbalance. Our starting point are BERT-based baselines trained with binary cross-entropy loss ( BCE ). To tackle class imbalance, we test variants of up-weighting positive instances compared to negative ones: uniformly up-weighting them ( Rathnayaka et al., 2019 , WBCEU , ) , up-weighting rare positive instances proportionally to class frequency ( WBCEM ), and up-weighting all positive instances proportionally to class frequency ( WBCEP ).
We also evaluate Multilabel Random Oversampling ( Charte et al., 2015 , ROS, ) , which assigns more importance to less frequent labels by oversampling them, and focal loss ( Lin et al., 2017 , FL, ) , which down-weights instances for which the model is already confidently correct (see App. A.3.2 for loss formulae).
blocks.zh:
解决阶级不平衡问题。 我们的起点是基于BERT的基线,训练有二进制的交叉性损失(BCE )。 为了解决班级失衡问题,我们测试了与负数相比的升重阳性病例的变体:统一升重(Rathnayaka等人,2019年,WBCEU,),与班级频率成比例的升重稀有阳性病例(WBCEM),与班级频率成比例的升重所有阳性病例(WBCEP)。
我们还评价了多标签随机超标(Chalte et al.,2015,ROS, ),该评价通过超标对少常见的标签给予更多的重视,以及焦损失(Lin et al.,2017,FL,),这些降低重量的例子模型已经自信地正确(损失公式见App.3.2).

blocks.en:
Multi-Label Classification with LLMs. Instead of treating multi-label classification as a standard classification problem with discriminative models, it can also be approached using generative models, ranging from fine-tuning methods ( Jung et al., 2023 , e.g.,) to few-shot prompting ( D’Oosterlinck et al., 2024 ; Milios et al., 2023 ; Zhu and Zamani, 2024 , e.g.,) . Inspired by these approaches, we design an LLM-based baseline system for multi-label prediction.
Our system utilizes Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Dubey et al., 2024 , Llama-3.3 ) or Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 , Qwen-2.5 ) , which for each prediction is prompted with a set of few-shot demonstrations from the training set, which are retrieved from a vector database ( Douze et al., 2024 , FAISS,) if the cosine similarity between their embeddings and the embedding of the test instance, computed using all-mpnet-base-v2 8 8 8 https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) , exceeds a tuned similarity threshold.
We compare this retrieval-enhanced system with zero-shot prompting of the underlying models.
For more details, see App. A.3.3 .

我们的系统使用Llama-3.3-70B-指令(Dubey等人,2024年;Llama-3.3)或Quen2.5-72B-指令(Yang等人,2024年;Quen-2.5),每一次预测都使用一套从培训组中提取的几发示意图,这些示意图是从矢量数据库(Douze等人,2024年;FAISS)中检索的,如果其嵌入与试样的嵌入之间的余弦相似性,使用所有-mpnet-base-v2 8 https://huggingface.co/senence-trans/all-mpnet-base-v2计算。 (Reimers and Gurevich, 2019),超过了调谐的相似性阈值.
我们比较了这个检索增强的系统 和零镜头激发的模型。
详情见App.A.3.3。

On both datasets, we run the experiments with five different random seeds, respectively, and report averages and standard deviations, with the exception of the LLM-based explorative experiments, where we greedily decode the outputs of a single run.
During fine-tuning, we train for 50 epochs.
If not otherwise indicated, we stop early with a patience of ten epochs based on the tune/dev set performance in development/evaluation runs.
When evaluating on the test set, we train on the combination of train and tune and select the best epoch on the dev set.
On RCV1, we tune hyperparameters for the BERT BCE baseline (see App. A.4.1 ).
For HiDEC-s HBM, we use Kim et al. (2024) ’s hyperparameters, and on MIMIC-III, we use Kim et al. (2022) ’s hyperparameters.
On both datasets, we tune the oversampling rate and γ \gamma for ML-ROS and FL, respectively (see Tables 7 and 9 in App. A.4.1 ). For an overview of model parameters, computational infrastructure and budget, see App. A.4.1 .

blocks.en: Binning Scheme Validation. We first apply our new binning scheme to validate it in comparison with fixed-width and adaptive binning. Fig. 2 compares ECEs computed based on the adaptive, fixed-width, and adaptive ML binning schemes on RCV1 and MIMIC-III. On both datasets, adaptive binning leads to ECE scores that strongly correlate with class frequency: the more frequent a class is, the less calibrated it seems according to adaptive binning, albeit models typically learn to perform better on more frequent classes. Adaptive binning results in low ECEs for non-frequent classes because for these labels, typically only a single bin contains positive predictions (see Fig. 1(b) ).

blocks.en:
Performance and Calibration of LLM-Based Classifiers. In a multi-label setting with many labels, retrieving instances with exactly the same labels assigned as the test instance usually cannot be expected.
Nevertheless, LLM-based classifiers heavily benefit from retrieved examples: their performance typically increases by around 20 points in macro F 1 compared to zero-shot prompting (see Table 18 in App. A.4.2 ).
The observed benefit of seeing examples from the input distribution and the label space is in line with prior work showing that few-shot prompting can work even with wrong or random labels ( Min et al., 2022 ; Yoo et al., 2022 ; Wei et al., 2023 ) .

尽管如此,基于LLM的分类器还是从检索到的例子中获益匪浅:它们的性能在宏观F 1中通常比零镜头提示增加约20点(见App.A.4.2.表18)。
所观察到的从输入分布和标签空间中看到实例的好处与先前的研究表明,即使有错误或随机的标签,也只能用很少的镜头提示(Min等人,2022年;Yoo等人,2022年;Wei等人,2023年)。

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 provides a frequency-group analysis of the best LLM-based and fine-tuned multi-label classifiers.
Fine-tuned models consistently outperform LLM-based ones in both performance and calibration.
For example, BERT with focal loss achieves lower ECE on frequent and medium-frequency labels.
Fine-tuned models are also far more efficient, running up to 10,000 times faster than RAG-based methods (see Table 13 in App. A.4.2 ). Thus, when sufficient training data is available, fine-tuned classifiers are the superior choice.
LLM-based classifiers, however, remain valuable in low-data settings, outperforming random and majority baselines.

例如,具有焦距的BERT在频繁和中频标签上实现了较低的欧洲经委会。
精细调试的模型同样效率要高得多,运行速度比基于RAG的方法快1万倍(见App.A.4.2.表13). 因此,在获得足够的培训数据时,对分类进行微调是首选。
然而,基于LLM的分类器在低数据环境、业绩优于随机和多数基线方面仍然很有价值。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we have addressed the limitations of existing calibration metrics when applied to multi-label text classification, particularly under severe class imbalance.
We have introduced a new calibration metric and an adaptive binning scheme that better capture per-label miscalibration and provide meaningful estimates.
Our empirical study on large-scale, imbalanced benchmarks demonstrates that fine-tuned classifiers trained with focal loss offer the most reliable balance of performance and calibration, while LLM-based classifiers remain less well-calibrated despite showing promising results with RAG.
Overall, our contributions provide a foundation for more robust evaluation and development of calibrated models in multi-label text classification, highlighting both effective current strategies and open challenges for future research.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们解决了在多标签文本分类中,特别是在严重类别不平衡的情况下,现有校准度量的局限性。
我们采用了新的校准度量衡和适应性强的宾装方案,以更好地捕捉每个标签的错误校准,并提供有意义的估计.
我们关于大规模不平衡基准的经验研究表明,经过精细调整的分类器在性能和校准方面提供了最可靠的平衡,而基于LLM的分类器则没有很好地校准,尽管在RAG中显示出有希望的结果。
总体而言,我们的贡献为在多标签文本分类中更有力地评价和开发校准模型奠定了基础,突出了当前有效的战略和未来研究面临的公开挑战。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Baan et al. (2022) argue that ECE and its variants are not meaningful if humans inherently disagree on label assignments for a given single-label task, because even the oracle classifier which perfectly models the human disagreement distribution will be miscalibrated according to these metrics.
They support this claim with a case study on ChaosNLI ( Nie et al., 2020 ) , a natural language inference (NLI) dataset consisting of instances with weak human annotator agreement.
Their proposed alternative approach requires a reliable estimate of the human judgement distribution, which can be difficult to obtain in practice and is, to the best of our knowledge, not available for the datasets in our study.
However, we agree that when using ECE ML \text{ECE}_{\text{ML}} to assess calibration, it should always be kept in mind that it measures calibration with respect to the gold standard.
blocks.zh:
Baan等人(2022年)认为,如果人类在某一单一标签任务的标签分配上存在固有的分歧,那么欧洲经委会及其变体就毫无意义,因为即使完美地模拟人类分歧分布的甲骨文分类器也会根据这些衡量标准进行错判。
他们以关于ChaosNLI(Nie等人,2020年)的案例研究来支持这一说法,该自然语言推论(NLI)数据集由人类注释员协议薄弱的事例组成。

然而,我们同意,在使用ECE ML\text{ECE\Text{ML}评估校准时,应始终铭记,它衡量金本位的校准。

blocks.en: A.1 Calibration Metrics for Multi-Label Calibration
blocks.zh: A.1 多标签校准标准

blocks.en:
If multi-label classification is modeled as multi-class classification over label sets, a predicted set counts as correct if and only if it exactly matches the ground truth set of applying labels ( Li et al., 2019 ) , thus not differentiating between almost correct solutions and those where the predicted label set notably deviates from the ground truth set.
If the prediction set probability is computed as the product of the per-label probabilities of assigning the label (if the specific label is contained in the prediction set) respectively the probability of not assigning it (if the label is not contained in the prediction set) ( Li, 2019 ) , the resulting prediction set probabilities become infinitesimally small with large label spaces.
For example, the MIMIC-III dataset consists of 8930 labels, and even an unrealistically good classifier that always assigns a probability of 0.99 0.99 to the correct per-label decision would only assign a probability of 0.99 8930 ≈ 1.05 × 10 − 39 0.99^{8930}\approx 1.05\times 10^{-39} to the ground-truth prediction set for a given instance.
Even the top-1 predictions will hence be associated with extremely low probabilities, making it hard to interpret them or even evaluate if they are calibrated.
blocks.zh:
如果多标签分类在标签集上作为多类分类的模型,一个预言集的计数是正确的,如果并且只有在它与应用标签的地面真象集(Li等人,2019年)完全吻合,因此没有区分几乎正确的解决方案和预言集明显偏离地面真象集的解决方案.
如果预测设定概率被分别作为每个标签指定标签概率的产物计算(如果具体标签包含在预测设定中),则不指定概率(如果该标签未包含在预测设定中) (李, 2019) , 由此产生的预测设定概率随着标签空间大而变得无限小.
例如,MIMIC-III数据集由8930个标签组成,即使一个不切实际的好分类器总是将0.99 0.99的概率分配给正确的每个标签决定,也只能将0.99 8930 × 1.05 × 10 − 39 0.99 × 8930 × 大约 1.05\时间 10 ×-39 } 分配给特定实例的地真相预测。
因此,即使是前1级的预测也会与极低的概率相关,因此很难解释,甚至难以评估是否经过校准。

blocks.en:
For testing in runtime-intensive scenarios, we create a subsampled version of the RCV1 testset containing 5,000 instances.
Drawing a representative subsample is nontrivial in the multi-label setting, as each instance can be associated with multiple labels.
Our goal was to preserve the original label distribution as closely as possible.
To achieve this, we designed a sampling algorithm that iteratively selects instances in a way that minimizes the difference in label frequencies between the subsample and the original test set.
Specifically, during each sampling iteration, we identify the label with the highest relative deficit (i.e., the largest underrepresentation compared to the full distribution) and randomly draw an instance that contains this label.
This process is repeated until the desired number of instances is reached. We ran the sampling procedure with 11 different random seeds and selected the subsample with the lowest Jensen–Shannon (JS) divergence from the original label distribution.
The final subsample has a JS divergence of 0.0344 from the original test set.
blocks.zh:
为了在运行时间密集的情景中进行测试,我们创建了含有5 000个实例的RCV1测试集的子样本版本。
绘制具有代表性的子样本在多标签设置中是非三角性的,因为每个实例都可以与多个标签相关联.
我们的目标是尽可能保持原有的标签发行.
为了实现这一点,我们设计了一个取样算法,它迭代地选择实例,以尽量减少子样本和原始测试集之间标签频率的差异.
具体地说,在每次取样迭代中,我们都会发现相对赤字最高的标签(即与完全分布相比代表比例最大的),并随机绘制一个包含这个标签的实例.
在达到理想的例数之前,会重复这一进程。 我们用11种不同的随机种子进行了取样程序,并以Jensen-Shannon(JS)与原标签分配的最小差异选择了子样本。
最终的子样本与原测试集的JS差异为0.0344.

blocks.en: A.3.1 HiDEC and HBM Loss
blocks.zh: A.3.1 HIDC和HBM损失

blocks.en:
Unlike other recent HTC methods that build hierarchy directly into their model structure, Im et al. (2023) treat hierarchical text classification as a sequence generation problem. Their Hierarchy DECoder (HiDEC) model uses an encoder-decoder setup to generate a sequence of labels representing a path through the label hierarchy.
HiDEC learns the relationships between labels along the hierarchy path, from the root to each leaf, using an attention mechanism combined with a special masking technique that focuses on parent-child label dependencies. This helps the model understand the hierarchical structure during training. The model then combines this hierarchical information with the text features to make better predictions.
During inference, HiDEC generates labels in a top-down manner, starting from parent labels and moving down to child labels, using a recursive decoding process that respects the hierarchy.
blocks.zh:
与最近其他将等级直接构建到其模型结构中的HTC方法不同,Im等人(2023年)将等级文字分类视为序列生成问题. 他们的等级DECoder(HiDEC)模型使用编码器-解码器设置,通过标签等级生成代表路径的标签序列.
HiDEC学习了从根到每个叶子的等级路径上的标签之间的关系,使用一种关注机制与一种特殊的遮掩技术结合,专注于亲子标签依赖性. 这有助于模型在培训期间了解等级结构。 模型然后将这种分级信息与文本特征结合起来,以作出更好的预测.
在推论期间,HiDEC以自上而下的方式生成标签,从母标签开始,向下移动到子标签,使用尊重等级的递归解码过程.

blocks.en:
Hierarchy-aware Biased Bound Margin (HBM) Loss ( Kim et al., 2024 ) is a hierarchy-aware loss function specifically designed for unit-based HTC models like HiDEC, addressing two central challenges: label imbalance and static thresholding. HBM Loss integrates learnable bounds, biases, and a margin. The biases and margin mitigate the label imbalance by promoting low-confidence labels and excluding high-confidence labels from a loss, respectively. The learnable bounds address the static thresholding problem. These bounds are optimized for all units within a hierarchy during training and serve as dynamic unit thresholds during inference.
In the context of the HiDEC model, a unit refers to the set of child labels associated with a given parent label in the label hierarchy. That is, when using HBM Loss with the HiDEC model, during hierarchical decoding, the model expands from parent to child labels in a top-down manner, applying a distinct threshold at each step of the sub-hierarchy expansion.
blocks.zh:
HiDEC等单位化的HTC模型专门设计了分级意识-认识双边边框(HBM)损失(Kim等人,2024年),处理两个中心挑战:标签不平衡和静态阈值. 氢气 损失包含可学习的界限、偏见和差额。 偏见和差值通过促进低信心标签和将高信心标签分别排除在损失之外来缓解标签的不平衡。 可学习界限解决静态阈值问题. 这些界限在训练期间被优化为一个等级内的所有单位,并在推断时作为动态单位阈值.
在HiDEC模型的上下文中,一个单位是指标签等级中与给定的父母标签相关的一组儿童标签. 也就是说,在使用HBM Loss与HiDEC模型时,在分级解码过程中,该模型以自上而下的方式从父母的标签扩展为孩子的标签,在子等级扩展的每个步骤上都适用一个明显的阈值.

blocks.en:
We use instruction-tuned variants of both the Llama 3.3 ( Dubey et al., 2024 ) and Qwen 2.5 ( Yang et al., 2024 ) models. These models are available in various sizes; specifically, we employ Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 9 9 9 https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 10 10 10 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct . The Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct model has 70 billion parameters and supports a context length of up to 128,000 tokens. The Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model consists of 72.7 billion parameters and supports a full context length of 131,072 tokens. For simplicity, we omit the “-3.3-70B-Instruct” and “2.5-72B-Instruct” suffixes in the model names throughout the following text.
These large models were chosen because their size and instruction tuning make them particularly capable of following complex prompts. Their long context length allows us to include a large number of in-context examples (few-shot demonstrations) directly within a single prompt, which is important for our underlying tasks of extreme multi-label text classification and sequence labeling.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Llama3.3(Dubey等人,2024年)和Quen 2.5(Yang等人,2024年)模型的指令调制变体。 这些模型大小各异;具体来说,我们使用Llama-3.3-70B-指示9 9 https://huggingface.co/meta-lama/Llama-33-70B-指示10 10 https://huggingface.co/Quen/Quen2.5-72B-Instruct。 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct模型有700亿个参数,支持上下文长度高达128,000个令牌. Quen2.5-72B-Instruct模型包含727亿参数,支持全上下文长度为131,072令牌. 简言之,我们省略了以下各段的模型名称中的“3.3-70B-指示”和“2.5-72B-指示”后缀。
之所以选择这些大型模型,是因为其尺寸和指示调制使它们特别能够遵循复杂的提示。 它们的长上下文长度使我们能够直接在一个提示内包含大量内文实例(few-shot example),这对我们极端多标签文本分类和序列标签的基本任务很重要.

blocks.en:
We prompt the LLMs as shown in Fig. 7 to predict the labels given the selected demonstrations, their corresponding labels, and the text of the current test instance for which the labels are to be predicted. For Token Prob. confidence estimation, we extract the probability of the first generated token corresponding to each label and use it to determine the model’s confidence.
For Verbalized confidence estimation, we construct a prompt for each predicted label that includes the selected demonstrations, their corresponding labels, the text of the current test instance, and the previously predicted labels. The LLM is then instructed to estimate its confidence in the predicted label on a scale from 0 to 1, as shown in Fig. 8 . This prompt is applied separately to each predicted label contained in the label space. Invalid predicted labels (i.e., labels not contained in the label space) are discarded.
blocks.zh:
我们提示图7所示的 LLMs 预测所选演示的标签, 它们的对应标签, 以及要预测标签的当前测试实例的文本 。 对于Token Prob.信心估计,我们提取出与每个标签相对应的第一个生成符号的概率,并用它来确定模型的自信.
对于虚化的置信估计,我们构建每个预测标签的提示,包括选定的演示,它们相应的标签,当前测试实例的文本,以及之前预测的标签. 然后,LLM被指示估计其对预测标签的置信度从0到1,如图8所示。 此提示被分别应用到标签空格中包含的每个预测标签. 无效的预测标签(即标签空格中未包含的标签)会被丢弃.

blocks.en:
We tune the retriever on the development set to achieve high recall while maintaining non-trivial precision. This balance is crucial in our use case because we want to provide the LLM with as many relevant candidate labels as possible, ensuring it has sufficient information to make accurate predictions. At the same time, we need to avoid overwhelming the model with too many irrelevant labels, which could reduce overall performance and increase computational cost. This process involves adjusting two key hyperparameters: the similarity threshold t t and t ​ o ​ p ​ - ​ k top\text{-}k . The similarity threshold defines the minimum required similarity between a document in the retrieval pool and the input text during inference. Only documents that exceed this threshold are selected into the demonstrations pool P P and are considered for the in-context demonstrations. The t ​ o ​ p ​ - ​ k top\text{-}k parameter determines how many of the most similar documents from the demonstrations pool P P are selected to serve as in-context demonstrations.
During this phase, the labels from the retrieved demonstrations are used directly as predictions.
The retriever is individually tuned for each dataset to optimize performance, resulting in t = 0.25 t=0.25 and t ​ o ​ p ​ - ​ k = 30 top\text{-}k=30 for RCV1 and in t = 0.3 t=0.3 and t ​ o ​ p ​ - ​ k = 10 top\text{-}k=10 for MIMIC-III.
On RCV1, we get a hierarchical macro recall of 87.8%, a hierarchical macro precision of 17.4%, and a hierarchical macro F 1 of 26.9%.
On MIMIC-III, the respective configuration yields a macro recall of 8.3%, a macro precision of 1.9%, and a macro F 1 of 2.9%, which is substantially lower
than the results obtained on RCV1. The lower performance is primarily due to the retriever struggling with rare labels.
blocks.zh:
我们调整开发装置上的检索器,以便在保持非三角精确性的同时实现高召回。 这种平衡对我们的使用至关重要,因为我们想向LLM提供尽可能多的相关候选标签,确保它有足够的信息来作出准确的预测。 同时,我们需要避免用太多不相关的标签来压倒模型,这会降低整体性能,增加计算成本. 这一过程涉及调整两个关键超参数:相似性阈值 t t和 t o p - k top\text{ -} k. 相似性阈值定义了检索池中的文档与推论中输入文本之间所需的最小相似性. 只有超过这个阈值的文件才被选入演示池PP,并被考虑用于内文演示. t o p - k top\ text{ -} k 参数决定了从演示池 P P 中选择多少最相似的文档作为内文本演示.
在这一阶段,取回的演示的标签被直接用作预测.
检索器为每个数据集单独调制,以优化性能,生成 t = 0.25 t = 0.25 and t o p - k = 30 上\ text{}k = 30 为RCV1,在 t = 0.3 t= 0.3 和 t o p - k = 10 上\ text{}k = 10为 MIC-III.
在RCV1上,我们得到的分级宏观召回率为87.8%,分级宏观精度为17.4%,分级宏观F1为26.9%.
在MIMIC-III上,相应的配置产生8.3%的宏观召回,1.9%的宏观精度,2.9%的宏观F 1,大大降低
与RCV1获得的结果相比。 性能较低主要是因为检索器与罕见的标签纠缠不休.

Here, we estimate the total computational effort for the experiments reported in our paper.
The numbers reported for HiDEC and the LLM-based models refer to 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
Inference with HiDEC and the LLM-based models on RCV1 dev, subsampled test, and full test took roughly 153 hours.

A single run with the PLM-ICD models took up to 3 days on the A100, whereas a single run with the BERT-style models took roughly 16 hours.

In this section, we compare the time required for training and inference across different approaches, highlighting trade-offs between LLM-based and supervised fine-tuning methods. An overview of the inference times for the RCV1 dataset splits is provided in Table 13 .
blocks.zh: 培训和推论运行时报. 在本节中,我们比较了不同方法的培训和推论所需的时间,强调了基于LLM和受监督的微调方法之间的权衡。 表13概述了RCV1数据集拆分的推断时间。

blocks.en:
LLMs require substantial inference time, especially in the RAG setting, where the prompt length increases due to the added demonstrations. For the RCV1 dataset, the size of the official test set presents a practical challenge. While the development set contains only 2,315 instances, inference with our RAG approach in the few-shot setting already takes up to 20 hours on 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. The full test set, however, comprises 781,261 instances, which would result in an estimated inference time of over 9 months.
This computational bottleneck motivated the creation of a subsampled test set, as described in App. A.2 . Even on this reduced subset, inference with RAG can take over 43 hours.
blocks.zh:
LLMs需要大量推断时间,特别是在RAG环境下,由于增加了演示,快速长度增加. 对于RCV1数据集,官方测试集的大小提出了实际挑战. 虽然开发集只包含2,315个实例,但用我们的RAG方法在几发设定中推断,在4个NVIDIA H100 GPU上已经耗时长达20小时. 不过,全套测试包括781 261例,估计推断时间超过9个月。
这个计算瓶颈促使创建了App描述的子样本测试集. A.2节。 即使在这个缩小的子集上,对RAG的推论可以超过43小时.

blocks.en:
In comparison, inference with HiDEC is significantly faster: it takes around 10 seconds on the development set, 15 seconds on the subsampled test set (5,000 instances), and approximately 30 minutes on the full test set. However, unlike the RAG approach, HiDEC requires training. Using HBM Loss, training HiDEC for 100 epochs without early stopping takes roughly 2.5 hours, with only minimal variation depending on whether the training set includes the tuning set.
Even when considering both training and inference, the total runtime for HiDEC remains substantially lower than that of the RAG-based methods. Moreover, training HiDEC for 50 epochs with early stopping yields nearly the same performance as training for 100 epochs without it, making the efficiency gap even more pronounced.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,与HiDEC的推论要快得多:在开发集上大约需要10秒,在分样测试集上大约需要15秒(5,000例),在全测试集上大约需要30分钟. 然而,与RAG方法不同,HiDEC需要培训. 使用HBM Loss(HBM Loss),训练100个世纪的HiDEC没有提前停止大约需要2.5小时,根据训练集是否包括调试集,只有最小的变数.
即使考虑到培训和推断,HIDC的总运行时间仍然大大低于基于RAG的方法。 此外,为50个提前停止的时代培训HiDEC的成绩与为100个没有这个时代的培训几乎相同,使效率差距更加明显。

Comparison of LLMs and Fine-Tuned Classifiers. Table 18 compares LLMs and fine-tuned classifiers in terms of their performance and calibration.
While zero-shot approaches perform notably worse and are considerably less well-calibrated than fine-tuned models, LLMs with RAG approach fine-tuned models in both performance and calibration.
However, their inference run time is substantially higher: Llama-3.3. with RAG takes almost 10,000 times as long as HiDEC (see Table 13 ).
